name: Littlestone Cardinality Equality Is Strictly Maximum
scope: Finite Boolean concept classes; fixed coordinates are retained only where the statement explicitly refers to the displayed ground set.
proof: The cardinality equality forces $\operatorname{VCdim}(H)=\operatorname{Ldim}(H)$ and ordinary Sauer equality. The adaptive chain is maximum but has Littlestone dimension two and fails the Littlestone cardinality equality.
